title: Cybersecurity Container Audit — NIST SP 800-190
description: Audits Dockerfile and docker-compose.yml against NIST SP 800-190 container hardening controls. For US federal contractors preparing a CMMC Level 2 assessment.

title: CRA Annex II User Docs Lint
description: Lints the user documentation that ships with your product against the mandatory Annex II items of the EU Cyber Resilience Act: support-period end date, vulnerability contact, EU DoC address, secure de

title: Consent Proof Record Lint (GDPR Art.7)
description: Lints stored consent-record JSON against the GDPR Article 7(1) proof-of-consent fields a supervisory authority asks for. Offline, no telemetry.

title: CRA Readiness Audit
description: Flags the lines in your repo that break the EU Cyber Resilience Act - default passwords, disabled TLS checks, floating base images, an expired security.txt - naming the Annex each one fails.

title: Codex Usage by Edd
description: Track remaining Codex 5-hour and weekly quota with live status bar progress bars.
